title: critoniopsis popayanensis
intro: Critoniopsis popayanensis, commonly known as the Popayan daisy or Popayan sunflower, is a flowering plant species that belongs to the Asteraceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from stress, anxiety, and inflammation due to its adaptogenic and anti-inflammatory properties. The health benefits of Critoniopsis popayanensis include its ability to improve sleep quality, boost the immune system, and reduce oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant are primarily flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects.
